g1|variants|pricing.family_title: SAP S/4HANA OTC Pricing and Condition Technique Variants
g1|variants|pricing.summary: This family covers standard SAP S/4HANA pricing variants used during sales document processing, factoring in condition types, scale pricing, manual overrides, and tax or rebate determinations. Variants differ based on how pricing originates (standard procedure, manual entry, condition records, or external engines) and how they influence billing output.

variants.name: Standard Condition Record Pricing (PR00)
variants.when_used: Standard sales orders where net price is derived automatically from maintained condition records using access sequences.
variants.key_config: Condition table assigned to access sequence, access sequence assigned to condition type PR00, and condition type included in pricing procedure RVAA01.

variants.name: Manual Price Override Entry (AMIZ / Manual)
variants.when_used: Negotiated sales scenarios where the sales representative manually overwrites the net price directly at the sales order item level.
variants.key_config: Condition type configured with manual entry allowed (setting 'C' or 'D') in pricing procedure and appropriate authorization granted via V_KOND_PHA.

variants.name: Scale Pricing by Quantity (PR00 with Scales)
variants.when_used: Volume discount tiers where the unit price drops based on ordered quantity thresholds defined in condition master records.
variants.key_config: Condition record maintained with scale type (Base scale or Interval scale) and scale basis indicator (Quantity/Weight/Volume).

variants.name: Taxes Determination (UTX1 / MWST)
variants.when_used: Calculating output taxes automatically based on customer tax classification, material tax classification, and departure/destination country.
variants.key_config: Condition category 'D' assigned to tax condition type, tax jurisdiction code structure activated, and tax destination determination configured.

variants.name: Rebate Agreement Processing (BO01 - BO06)
variants.when_used: Post-billing customer rebates accumulating over time based on total sales volume for settlement processing in SD/FI.
variants.key_config: Rebate indicator activated in billing type, sales organization, and customer master; condition types tied to rebate accrual routines.

variants.name: Advanced Variant Pricing (Characteristics-based)
variants.when_used: Configurable products (IPC/Variant Configuration) where pricing is dynamically calculated based on selected characteristic values.
variants.key_config: Variant condition keys linked to characteristic values via object dependencies and condition records maintained for variant keys.

compare_groups.covers: How SAP selects the correct pricing procedure based on sales area, customer pricing procedure, and document pricing procedure.

compare_groups.name: Condition Technique & Access Sequences
compare_groups.covers: Configuration of condition tables, access sequences, and search strategies for master data retrieval.

compare_groups.name: Pricing Routines & Formulas
compare_groups.covers: Custom requirements, alternative calculation formulas, and base value formulas assigned to pricing steps.

compare_groups.name: Master Data & Condition Records
compare_groups.covers: Maintenance of condition records, validity periods, scales, and currency conversions.

compare_groups.name: Integration & Error Handling
compare_groups.covers: Handling pricing errors in sales orders, incompletion logs, pricing log analysis, and billing blocks.

g1|core|pricing|standard condition recor.title: Standard Condition Record Pricing (PR00)
g1|core|pricing|standard condition recor.story: Imagine a giant cash register that automatically knows the exact price of every item sold by looking up secret price tags stored in a giant filing cabinet. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash (OTC), standard condition record pricing calculates the net value of a sales order by reading condition technique elements like access sequences, condition tables, and pricing procedures. When a sales representative creates a customer order, the system searches through condition records for condition type PR00, applies the valid price, and passes the calculated monetary amounts down to outbound delivery and billing documents. If this pricing engine is misconfigured, sales orders show zero prices, billing documents fail to generate accounting postings, and company revenue reporting breaks completely.
g1|core|pricing|standard condition recor.why_business_needs_it: Automated standard pricing ensures that every customer receives accurate, legally compliant prices based on customer and material combinations without manual intervention. It drives the financial backbone of the Order-to-Cash process by feeding precise revenue values into billing and General Ledger (GL) postings.

modules.role: Executes the pricing determination during sales order entry and pricing persistence in billing.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for revenue posting via Billing.

modules.role: Receives condition type values through condition-to-account determination for revenue posting.

prerequisites: Organizational Units (Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, Division) -- Enterprise Structure T-code: OX01 / SPRO
Customer Master Data (Sales Area View) -- T-code: XD01 / BP
Material Master Data (Sales Organization 1 and 2 Views) -- T-code: MM01
Pricing Procedure Determination (Pricing Procedure assigned to Sales Area and Customer/Document Pricing Procedures) -- T-code: V/08 / SPRO

config_steps.where: V/03 -- SPRO > Logistics Execution > Logistics Execution Dashboard / Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define Condition Tables
config_steps.values: Table: 304; Fields: Sales Organization, Customer, Material
config_steps.check: Run transaction V/03, enter table 304, and verify that the fields Sales Organization, Customer, and Material are present in the key structure.
config_steps.why: Condition tables dictate the exact combination of fields SAP searches to find a specific price for a sales order item.
config_steps.if_missing: Without the condition table, pricing cannot look up specific customer-material price combinations, resulting in message VK001.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/03 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Table number 304 in the Condition Table field and press Change
Double-click on Sales Organization from the selected fields list to include it
Double-click on Customer from the selected fields list to include it
Double-click on Material from the selected fields list to include it
Click Generate (Ctrl+F3) to create the database table
Click Yes on the system generation prompt and save with a customizing transport request

fields.note: Custom condition table number for pricing
Key combination fields for pricing lookups

config_steps.where: V/07 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define Access Sequences
config_steps.values: Access Sequence: PR00; Access: Table 304 with exclusive flag set
config_steps.check: Run transaction V/07, navigate to access sequence PR00, and confirm table 304 is assigned with the Exclusive flag checked.
config_steps.why: The access sequence tells the pricing engine the search strategy and hierarchy it must follow to find a price condition record.
config_steps.if_missing: Without an access sequence, condition types cannot search condition tables, causing sales orders to price at zero.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/07 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries or select an existing access sequence and click Accesses folder
Enter Access Sequence PR00 and Description 'Standard Pricing Access'
Select the access sequence row and double-click Accesses in the dialog structure
Click New Entries to add access step 10
Enter Table 304 in the Table field
Select the Exclusive checkbox to stop searching once a valid condition record is found
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to a customizing transport request

fields.note: Stops search at the first matching record

config_steps.where: V/06 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define Condition Types
config_steps.values: Condition Type: PR00; Access Sequence: PR00; Calculation Type: B; Condition Class: A
config_steps.check: Run transaction V/06, select condition type PR00, and verify its access sequence and calculation type settings.
config_steps.why: Condition types represent the individual pricing elements, such as base prices or taxes, that form the total net value in an order.
config_steps.if_missing: Without condition type PR00 defined, the pricing procedure cannot process base prices, leading to unpriced sales orders.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/06 in the command field and press Enter
Select condition type PR00 and click Details (magnifying glass) or Copy As
Verify Condition Class is set to A (Discount or surcharge / Price)
Verify Calculation Type is set to B (Fixed amount / Percentage)
Enter Access Sequence PR00 in the Access Sequence field
Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the transport request

fields.note: Linked access sequence for record retrieval
Classifies the condition as a price

config_steps.where: V/08 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define and Assign Pricing Procedures
config_steps.values: Pricing Procedure: RVAA01; Step: 10; Counter: 0; Condition Type: PR00; From: 0; To: 0; Manual: blank; Mandatory: X
config_steps.check: Run transaction V/08, select pricing procedure RVAA01, and inspect the control data to ensure step 10 has condition type PR00 marked mandatory.
config_steps.why: The pricing procedure determines the sequence in which condition types are calculated in sales orders and billing documents.
config_steps.if_missing: Without a valid pricing procedure setup, sales orders cannot calculate net values or pass amounts to billing.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/08 in the command field and press Enter
Select pricing procedure RVAA01 and double-click Control Data
Click New Entries to add a pricing step
Enter Step 10, Counter 0, and Condition Type PR00
Enter From 0 and To 0
Leave Manual blank and check the Mandatory checkbox
Enter Account Key ERL
Save (Ctrl+S) and transport the changes

fields.note: Makes the condition mandatory on the order
Links condition value to revenue posting

config_steps.where: V/08 (Determination screen) -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define and Assign Pricing Procedures
config_steps.values: Sales Area: 1000 / 10 / 00; Doc. Pric. Proc.: A; Cust. Pric. Proc.: 1; Pricing Procedure: RVAA01
config_steps.check: Run transaction V/08, go to the determination screen, and verify that sales area 1000/10/00 mapped with doc pricing proc A and customer pricing proc 1 resolves to pricing procedure RVAA01.
config_steps.why: Pricing procedure determination links customer master and sales document type criteria to the correct pricing procedure for the sales area.
config_steps.if_missing: If determination is missing, the system cannot assign a pricing procedure to sales orders, resulting in message V1313.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/08 in the command field, select Pricing Procedure Determination, and click Choose
Click New Entries
Enter Sales Organization 1000, Distr. Channel 10, and Division 00
Enter Doc. Pric. Proc. A and Cust. Pric. Proc. 1
Enter Pricing Procedure RVAA01
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to a transport request

config_steps.where: VKOA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions / Account Assignment / Costing > Revenue Account Determination > Assign Revenue Accounts
config_steps.values: Application: V; Condition Table: 001; Chart of Accounts: INT; Sales Org: 1000; Acct Det. Procedure: KOFI00; Account Key: ERL; G/L Account: 800000
config_steps.check: Run transaction VKOA, select table 001, and verify that account key ERL maps to G/L account 800000 for sales organization 1000.
config_steps.why: Revenue account determination ensures that pricing amounts calculated in sales orders flow into the correct financial general ledger accounts during billing.
config_steps.if_missing: Without revenue account determination, billing document release to accounting fails with message FF709, blocking financial posting.
actions: Enter transaction /nVKOA in the command field and press Enter
Double-click on table 001 (Access sequence KOFI00 with account determination)
Click New Entries
Enter Application V, Chart of Accounts INT, Sales Org 1000, Acct Det. Procedure KOFI00, and Account Key ERL
Enter G/L Account 800000
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to a customizing transport request

config_steps.where: VK11 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Master Data > Conditions > Pricing > Create
config_steps.values: Condition Type: PR00; Sales Organization: 1000; Distribution Channel: 10; Customer: 100000; Material: M-01; Amount: 150.00 USD
config_steps.check: Run transaction VK13, enter condition type PR00, select the key combination, and display the record for material M-01 and customer 100000 to confirm the 150.00 USD rate.
config_steps.why: Condition records provide the specific monetary amounts that the pricing engine retrieves when processing sales orders.
config_steps.if_missing: Without condition records, sales orders default to zero price, preventing proper billing and revenue recognition.
actions: Enter transaction /nVK11 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Condition Type PR00 and press Enter
Select key combination Sales Organization / Customer / Material and click Continue
Enter Sales Organization 1000, Distribution Channel 10, Customer 100000, and Material M-01
Enter Amount 150.00 and Currency USD in the rate table
Save (Ctrl+S) to generate the condition record

config_steps.step: Create Sales Order with Automatic Pricing
config_steps.where: VA01 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Order > Create
config_steps.values: Order Type: OR; Sales Area: 1000/10/00; Sold-To: 100000; Material: M-01; Qty: 1
config_steps.check: Run transaction VA03, enter the sales order number, and verify that the net price displays 150.00 USD derived via condition type PR00.
config_steps.why: Creating a sales order tests the complete pricing determination flow from master data records to transactional document pricing.
config_steps.if_missing: If pricing fails during order creation, the order cannot be processed downstream for delivery and billing, triggering pricing error logs.
actions: Enter transaction /nVA01 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Order Type OR and Sales Area 1000 / 10 / 00, then press Enter
Enter Sold-To Party 100000 and Customer Reference 'Pricing Test'
Enter Material M-01 and Order Quantity 1 in the item overview grid
Press Enter and verify that Net Value calculates automatically as 150.00 USD
Save (Ctrl+S) and note the generated sales order number

config_steps.step: Verify Item Pricing Details in Sales Order
config_steps.where: VA02 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Order > Change
config_steps.values: Document: Sales Order; Tab: Conditions; Condition Type: PR00
config_steps.check: Run transaction VA03, go to item conditions, and check that condition type PR00 displays the correct amount and successful access analysis.
config_steps.why: Inspecting item conditions allows consultants to debug pricing determination issues and verify how condition records are accessed.
config_steps.if_missing: Without condition analysis review, pricing errors remain hidden, leading to incorrect customer invoicing.
actions: Enter transaction /nVA02 in the command field and press Enter
Enter the sales order number and press Enter
Select the item row for Material M-01 and click Item Details (magnifying glass)
Click on the Conditions tab to view pricing analysis
Verify that condition type PR00 appears with value 150.00 USD and access sequence status is green
Save (Ctrl+S) if any changes were made

config_steps.step: Create Outbound Delivery Based on Sales Order
config_steps.where: VL01N -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Shipping and Transportation > Outbound Delivery > Create > Single Document > With Order Reference
config_steps.screen_title: Create Outbound Delivery with Order Reference
config_steps.check: Run transaction VL03N and verify the outbound delivery document is created with correct item quantities and pricing reference.
config_steps.why: Outbound deliveries transfer priced sales order quantities into the logistics execution process for physical picking, packing, and shipping.
config_steps.if_missing: Without an outbound delivery, physical goods cannot leave the warehouse and billing cannot be initiated, halting the OTC cycle.
actions: Enter transaction /nVL01N in the command field and press Enter
Enter Shipping Point 1000, Selection Date, and Sales Order number
Press Enter to populate delivery items from the sales order
Verify delivery quantity matches the sales order quantity
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to create the outbound delivery document

config_steps.where: VL02N -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Shipping and Transportation > Outbound Delivery > Change > Single Document
config_steps.screen_title: Change Outbound Delivery: Outbound Delivery Details
config_steps.values: Delivery Number: Outbound delivery; Action: Post Goods Issue
config_steps.check: Run transaction VL03N, check document flow, and confirm that Goods Issue status shows Completely Processed.
config_steps.why: Posting goods issue reduces inventory levels in warehouse management and signals that the physical shipment has occurred, enabling billing.
config_steps.if_missing: Without PGI, the delivery remains unfulfilled, blocking subsequent billing creation and revenue recognition.
actions: Enter transaction /nVL02N in the command field and press Enter
Enter the outbound delivery number and press Enter
Click Post Goods Issue button in the top application toolbar
Verify status bar message indicates goods issue has been posted successfully
Save (Ctrl+S) if required

config_steps.where: VF01 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Document > Create
config_steps.values: Reference Document: Outbound Delivery; Net Value: 150.00 USD
config_steps.check: Run transaction VF03, enter the billing document number, and confirm that the pricing and net value match the original sales order.
config_steps.why: Billing documents transfer the priced order and delivery data into financial accounting to request payment from the customer.
config_steps.if_missing: Without billing documents, the company cannot invoice customers or recognize revenue, breaking the financial leg of the OTC cycle.
actions: Enter transaction /nVF01 in the command field and press Enter
Enter the Outbound Delivery number in the document list field
Press Enter to generate the billing item with pricing pulled from the sales order
Verify the net value equals 150.00 USD
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to create the billing document and post accounting

config_steps.step: Release Billing Document to Financial Accounting
config_steps.where: VF02 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Document > Change
config_steps.values: Billing Document: Billing Number; Action: Release to Accounting
config_steps.check: Run transaction VF03, view document flow, and verify that an accounting document is linked with status green.
config_steps.why: Releasing the billing document to financial accounting posts the revenue to general ledger accounts and creates customer receivables.
config_steps.if_missing: Without release to accounting, revenue remains unposted in general ledger accounts, causing discrepancies in financial reporting.
actions: Enter transaction /nVF02 in the command field and press Enter
Enter the billing document number and press Enter
Click Billing Document menu -> Release to Accounting
Verify status bar message indicates accounting document has been created successfully
Click Goto -> Header -> Accounting to view the generated financial posting
Save (Ctrl+S) and exit

run_steps.step: Create Sales Order with automatic pricing
run_steps.result: Sales order is created; pricing procedure RVAA01 evaluates condition type PR00, returning the correct rate from condition record.

run_steps.step: Verify item pricing details in sales order
run_steps.result: Condition tab on item level shows PR00 value correctly determined with active access sequence.

run_steps.step: Create Outbound Delivery based on sales order
run_steps.result: Outbound delivery document is generated, carrying forward pricing and value information.
Inventory is reduced and cost of goods sold is recorded.
Billing document is created, aggregating net values via pricing procedure RVAA01.

run_steps.step: Release Billing Document to Financial Accounting
run_steps.result: Accounting document is generated, posting revenue to G/L account via account key ERL.

errors.title: Condition record missing for PR00
errors.message_text: No pricing procedure could be determined
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot find the price tag for this item, so it puts a price of zero.
errors.cause: Condition record for condition type PR00 does not exist in access sequence PR00 for the given key combination.
errors.verify: Re-create sales order in VA01, enter the material, and verify the PR00 condition rate populates correctly on the Conditions tab.
errors.prevent: Ensure pricing condition records are loaded via data migration or manually created prior to user acceptance testing for all active sales materials.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Defining Condition Records

fix_steps.values: Select key combination such as Customer/Material or Price List/Currency

errors.title: Pricing procedure determination missing
errors.message_text: Pricing procedure &1 could not be determined
errors.plain_meaning: The system does not know which calculation sheet to use for this customer and sales area.
errors.cause: Missing assignment in pricing procedure determination for Sales Area, Document Pricing Procedure, and Customer Pricing Procedure.
errors.verify: Create a new sales order in VA01 and confirm pricing procedure RVAA01 appears in the analysis on the item Conditions tab.
errors.prevent: Verify pricing procedure determination rules are fully configured across all new sales areas during organizational unit extensions.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Pricing Procedure Determination

fix_steps.step: Go to pricing procedure determination view
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Pricing -> Pricing Control -> Define And Assign Pricing Procedures -> Assign Pricing Procedures
fix_steps.values: Sales Org, Dist. Chl, Division, Doc. Pricing Proc, Cust. Pricing Proc
Set Pricing Procedure to RVAA01 for the matching combination

errors.title: Access sequence missing condition table
errors.plain_meaning: The search path for finding prices is broken because a lookup table is missing.
errors.cause: Access sequence PR00 points to a condition table that is not generated or does not exist in the system.
errors.verify: Execute VK11 for condition type PR00 and verify the system successfully accesses the key combination screen without error.
errors.prevent: Never delete standard delivered SAP condition tables from access sequences without creating custom replacement tables.

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Pricing -> Pricing Control -> Define Access Sequences

fix_steps.values: Ensure valid Condition Table numbers (e.g. table 304) are assigned

errors.title: Condition type control data incorrect for PR00
errors.message_text: Condition type PR00 has invalid control data
errors.plain_meaning: The fundamental calculation rules for the price condition type are set up incorrectly.
errors.cause: Condition type PR00 calculation type is not set to B (Fixed amount / Percentage) or is missing access sequence assignment.
errors.verify: Re-open VK11 or check pricing analysis in a test order to ensure PR00 evaluates using calculation type B.
errors.prevent: Maintain strict change control over standard pricing configuration objects to prevent accidental modification of SAP delivered condition types.

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Pricing -> Pricing Control -> Define Condition Types

fix_steps.step: Update calculation type and access sequence
fix_steps.values: Calculation type: B, Access Sequence: PR00

errors.title: Pricing procedure RVAA01 missing step for PR00
errors.message_text: Condition type PR00 is missing in pricing procedure RVAA01
errors.plain_meaning: The price calculation sheet does not include the standard price condition type.
errors.cause: Condition type PR00 is omitted from the pricing procedure control lines for RVAA01.
errors.verify: Run pricing analysis in VA01 for a sales order item and verify PR00 is successfully called from pricing procedure RVAA01.
errors.prevent: Ensure transport requests containing pricing procedure modifications include all dependent condition type entries.

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Pricing -> Pricing Control -> Define And Assign Pricing Procedures -> Maintain Pricing Procedures

fix_steps.values: Step: 10, Counter: 0, Condition Type: PR00, From: 0, To: 0

errors.title: Customer master missing customer pricing procedure
errors.message_text: Pricing procedure &1 could not be determined
errors.plain_meaning: The customer record lacks the attribute needed to trigger the price list procedure.
errors.cause: Customer master sales area view (transaction XD03 or BP) has an empty Customer Pricing Procedure field in the Sales/Billing tab.
errors.verify: Create a new sales order for this customer in VA01 and check that pricing procedure RVAA01 resolves automatically.
errors.prevent: Include customer pricing procedure as a mandatory field in customer master data creation checklists and business partner templates.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Customer Master Data

fix_steps.step: Open business partner in sales and distribution role
fix_steps.values: Select Customer role -> Sales and Distribution -> Billing documents tab
